comment: The contract of the scripts of this skill: the exit codes of ask.py, spawn.py, handoff.py and role_set.py with a short meaning, the marker lines of ask.py, and the backend refusal codes of each script. ask.py, spawn.py, handoff.py, role_set.py and the herdr-watch extension read this file. The roles are in roles.json. The tables in SKILL.md and SPAWN.md tell an agent what to do for each code.

usage.meaning: usage error or bad target, nothing sent

busy.meaning: busy, the pane works on another turn, nothing sent

blocked.meaning: blocked on a question, read the screen

no_turn.meaning: no turn started, read the screen

api_error.meaning: API error, the transcript holds no other reply

ask.no_new_reply_line: NO NEW REPLY in the transcript
ask.no_transcript_line: NO TRANSCRIPT PATH from Herdr for this pane
ask.api_error_note: note: reply was an API error
ask.no_block_note: note: no result block; the pane may not be done. Read the screen.

failed.meaning: the start failed, spawn.py closed the new pane again

invalid.meaning: an input is not valid, nothing was started

startup_question.meaning: the agent stopped at a startup question, the pane stays open

done.meaning: the handoff is recorded and the previous coordinator pane closes

usage.meaning: usage error, a failed check, or not a coordinator, nothing was started

spawn_failed.meaning: spawn.py failed, or its output has no pane ID

startup_question.meaning: the new coordinator stopped at a startup question, both panes stay open

not_accepted.meaning: no confirmed reply from the new coordinator, both panes stay open

record_failed.meaning: the record of the handoff was not written, both panes stay open

send_failed.meaning: the second prompt failed: the new coordinator is blocked on a question, busy, started no turn, gave no new reply or an API error, or ask.py did not end, both panes stay open

close_failed.meaning: the handoff is done, but Herdr did not close the previous coordinator pane

role_set.space_id: opaque non-empty UTF-8 string with no whitespace and no control characters; passed to hc as one argument without a shell
role_set.unknown_space: exit 0 with zero actions: a well-formed ID with no live local terminal is an empty space, not bad input
role_set.handoff_command: carries the target harness before the model (<prefix> <harness> <model> [<thinking>] [roles=<role>:<harness>:<model>[:<thinking>],...]); the roles= argument holds the task roles researcher, worker, reviewer of the set, in this order, and is absent with no task role; a coordinator choice with the harness agy gives no handoff

ok.meaning: dry run printed, empty or unknown space (zero actions), or all actions finished

failed.meaning: an action, herdr-core call, or internal error failed

invalid.meaning: bad input: unknown label, unknown version, or missing or invalid space (empty, whitespace, control character, or invalid UTF-8)

backend.comment: Each script selects its backend before any terminal action. herdr1: Herdr 1 (`herdr`). core: herdr-core (`herdr-core` or `hc`) with the Herdr app; spawn.py (hc run), init.py, panes.py, ask.py, last-reply.py, close.py and handoff.py are ported to it, in a terminal with the labels herdr.space and herdr.tab. With no HC_TERMINAL_ID the backend is herdr1. Else each candidate must be live and an ancestor of the calling process; when both are valid, the candidate with the nearer root (the inner one) wins; equal roots or neither: refuse. On a refusal, each script does nothing and exits with its code below. A ported script on a core terminal without these labels also refuses with its code.
